parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate how different surfaces absorb thermal radiation. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 2.1. The apparatus is set up for you. A screen is provided to the side of the lamp in order to shield your eyes from direct glare. Do not place it between the lamp and the thermometer. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Adjust the distance d between the lamp and the thermometer so that it is approximately 1 cm. You are provided with a spacer to do this.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) In Table 2.1, record the initial temperature θ (with the lamp switched off).

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Switch on the lamp. In Table 2.1, record the temperature θ at 60 s intervals until you have a total of 5 values up to t = 240 s. Switch off the lamp.

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Replace the white card with the piece of black card, making sure that it makes good contact with the thermometer bulb.

parts.label: vi
parts.text: (vi) When the thermometer has cooled down, repeat steps (ii) and (iii) .

parts.label: vii
parts.text: (vii) Complete the column headings in the table. Table 2.1 white card black card t / θ / θ / [4]
